title: The Bet
focus: what fifteen years of solitude teach

teacherSummary.text: At a party a banker bets a young lawyer two million rubles that he cannot stay fifteen years in solitary confinement. The lawyer reads everything, from stories to languages and theology. On the eve of the end the ruined banker plans to kill him, but finds a letter renouncing the money and all worldly goods as vanity. The lawyer escapes five hours early, forfeiting; the banker locks the letter in his safe.
